description: This file defines classes and methods for sanitizing HTML content, including handling XHTML, MathML, SVG, and inline styles. It includes token filtering, attribute validation, and CSS sanitization.

classes.name: HTMLSanitizerMixin
classes.description: Provides methods and constants for sanitizing HTML tokens, attributes, and CSS styles.

classes.name: HTMLSanitizer
classes.description: Extends HTMLTokenizer with sanitization capabilities, yielding sanitized HTML tokens.

methods.name: sanitize_token
methods.description: Filters tokens based on allowed elements and attributes, sanitizing or disallowing as needed.

methods.name: allowed_token
methods.description: Processes tokens that are allowed, sanitizing attributes and styles.

methods.name: disallowed_token
methods.description: Replaces disallowed tokens with sanitized representations.

methods.name: sanitize_css
methods.description: Sanitizes CSS style strings, allowing only permitted properties and keywords.
